## Download

| Your Mac | File |
|---|---|
| Apple silicon (M1, M2, M3, M4…) | **Inlet-VERSION-arm64.dmg** |
| Intel | **Inlet-VERSION-x64.dmg** |

Not sure? Apple menu → **About This Mac**. It says "Chip: Apple …" for Apple silicon, or "Processor: Intel …". Needs macOS 13 Ventura or later.

## Install

1. Open the `.dmg` and drag **Inlet** into **Applications**.
2. The first time, **right-click** Inlet in Applications → **Open** → **Open**.
   Inlet is free and not signed with a paid Apple certificate, so macOS asks once.
   No Open button? Try opening it once, then go to **System Settings → Privacy & Security** → **Open Anyway**.
3. When asked, allow Inlet to access your Downloads folder.

**Updating:** quit Inlet from its menu bar icon, then install the new version the same way. Your settings, rules and history are kept.

Prefer to build it yourself? See the [README](https://github.com/Tech-Reign-Era-Services/inlet#build-it-yourself).
